title: The Overcoat
author: Nikolai Gogol
publication_note: first published in «Сочинения Николая Гоголя», vol. 3, St Petersburg, 1842
source_note: Text from ru.wikisource.org, after N. V. Gogol, Complete Works (1937–1952), vol. 3.

episodes.title: The Clerk and His Overcoat
episodes.blurb: Akaky Akakievich Bashmachkin, the humblest copying clerk in St Petersburg, is mocked by his colleagues and loves only his work, until the frost and a tailor named Petrovich teach him he needs a new overcoat.

episodes.title: The Party, the Theft and the Ghost
episodes.blurb: The new overcoat brings one happy evening and a night on an empty square. Then come a policeman, an Important Person who shouts, a fever, and a ghost who walks the streets of St Petersburg.

summary: Akaky Akakievich is a poor copying clerk in St Petersburg whom everyone mocks and whose only joy is his work. When his old overcoat falls apart, he saves for months to buy a new one, and for one evening he is happy. One of the most influential stories in Russian literature.
site_description: Akaky Akakievich Bashmachkin is a humble copying clerk in St Petersburg, mocked by colleagues and content with his papers, until his old overcoat can no longer be mended. He starves himself to save for a new one, and for a single evening he is happy; then comes a night on an empty square, an Important Person who will not listen, and a ghost. Gogol's 1842 masterpiece of pity, comedy and the supernatural, the story from which, as Russians say, all of their literature came.

ru.description: Акакий Акакиевич Башмачкин, бедный петербургский переписчик, которого все обижают и которому дорога только его работа, копит на новую шинель и один вечер бывает счастлив. Потом пустая площадь, значительное лицо, не пожелавшее выслушать, и привидение. Повесть Гоголя 1842 года.
